category1.title: Commure Secures $70M Led by General Catalyst to Scale Agentic AI for Healthcare
category1.snippet: Healthcare AI platform Commure raised $70M led by General Catalyst to scale agentic AI systems automating administrative and clinical workflows across hospitals, with Sequoia and Morgan Stanley participating.

category1.title: Writer Launches AI Agents That Act Without Prompts, Taking On Amazon, Microsoft, and Salesforce
category1.snippet: Writer launched autonomous AI agents that initiate and execute tasks without user prompts, positioning itself as an enterprise AI platform rival to Amazon, Microsoft, and Salesforce offerings.

category1.title: ServiceNow and Accenture Launch Forward Deployed Engineering Program to Scale Agentic AI Across the Enterprise
category1.snippet: ServiceNow and Accenture announced a forward deployed engineering program to help large enterprises move agentic AI from pilot projects to full production scale.

category1.title: Camunda Announces ProcessOS: Agentic AI Intelligence Layer for Business Process Optimization
category1.snippet: Camunda announced ProcessOS, an AI-powered intelligence layer that discovers, re-engineers, and continuously optimizes business processes as agentic workflows, entering closed beta May 20, 2026.

category1.title: Claude Managed Agents Gets Public-Beta Self-Hosted Sandboxes and MCP Tunnels
category1.snippet: Anthropic updated Claude Managed Agents with self-hosted sandboxes and research-preview MCP tunnels, enabling enterprises to run agents within their own controlled infrastructure connected to private MCP servers.

category2.title: Fiserv Launches agentOS: The Operating System for Agentic AI in Banking
category2.snippet: Fiserv launched agentOS, an agentic AI operating system for financial institutions to deploy, manage, and scale AI agents. Six institutions co-developed it; two are in beta. Wider rollout expected August 2026.

category2.title: FIS Brings Agentic AI to Banking With Anthropic, Starting With Financial Crimes
category2.snippet: FIS and Anthropic partner to deploy a Financial Crimes AI Agent that compresses AML investigations from hours to minutes. BMO and Amalgamated Bank are first deployers; broader availability planned for H2 2026.

category2.title: Broadridge Deploys Agentic AI Across Capital Markets
category2.snippet: Broadridge has deployed agentic AI across its capital markets operations, automating complex multi-step workflows in post-trade processing, reconciliation, and investor communications.

category2.title: KPMG Integrates Claude Across Its 276,000-Person Global Workforce in Strategic Alliance With Anthropic
category2.snippet: KPMG announced a strategic alliance with Anthropic to integrate Claude AI across its core business and workforce of more than 276,000 employees, one of the largest enterprise AI deployments in professional services.

category3.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 4.7 With Major Gains in Advanced Software Engineering
category3.snippet: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.7, a notable step up from Opus 4.6 in advanced software engineering and the hardest tasks, now available across Claude products, API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry.

category3.title: Google Announces Gemini 4.0 Omni at I/O 2026: Unified Text, Image, and Video in One Model
category3.snippet: Google unveiled Gemini 4.0 Omni at I/O 2026, a unified multimodal model generating text, images, and video in a single pipeline, positioned to rival GPT-5.5 with new Android and XR glasses integrations.

category3.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Dreaming' for Claude Managed Agents: Persistent Memory Consolidation Between Sessions
category3.snippet: Anthropic launched Dreaming, a research preview for Claude Managed Agents API that consolidates persistent memory between sessions by merging duplicates and removing stale entries, enabling stateful long-running agents.

category3.title: Claude Developer Platform Now Returns Richer SEC Filing Data for Financial Research Agents
category3.snippet: The Claude Developer Platform added enhanced SEC filing data returns with citations, making it easier to build financial research agents, earnings analysis workflows, and due-diligence tools grounded in primary sources.
